comparisons.postDeviation: Observed log employment change minus 2015–2019 fitted slope × elapsed years; descriptive only

controls: Age/education/native industry composition descriptors, not causal adjustment. Remote-work/offshoring/geography/occupation fixed effects need a later reviewed design.

definition.quintileFormula: min(5, floor(percentile * 5) + 1); tied scores stay together
definition.weighting: one native source occupation per record; no employment weighting

definition.quintileFormula: min(5, floor(percentile * 5) + 1); tied scores stay together
definition.weighting: one native source occupation per record; no employment weighting

guardrail: Observed differences across AI-exposure groups do not establish that AI caused those differences.
incompleteYearRule: Separate YTD; compare identical calendar months in prior years, never compare partial year employment with full annual employment
oewsUse: Cross-sectional context/coverage only; no OEWS annual growth path

pretrend.method: OLS log employment on year; exp(slope)-1 annual growth; Q5–Q1 gap

primarySample.balancedEmploymentPanel: All complete 2015–2025 years pass occupation employment suppression. Fixed group membership; excluded records retained.
primarySample.censusBridge: Official Census 2010→2018 bijection, identical detailed SOC code in both versions
primarySample.exposureBridge: Exactly one current O*NET child with a native capability value; Microsoft exact detailed SOC value separately

robustness: academic vs Microsoft, separate fixed source-native groups
common intersection sample, source groups retained
2026 YTD vs matched-month 2022 YTD; no full-year extrapolation
suppressionRule: Null suppressed values with reason, never zero fill; missing months invalidate full annual estimates; person-month counts are not unique persons
uncertainty: DESIGN_SE_UNAVAILABLE; repeated rotation/person-month observations and complex design prevent naive IID intervals; point estimates not exact; no significance claims

universes.earnings: Outgoing rotations HRMIS 4/8, wage/salary PEIO1COW 1–5, positive PTERNWA, PWORWGT; usual nominal weekly earnings, no real wage construction
universes.employment: PRPERTYP=2, age>=16, PEMLR in [1,2], valid positive PWCMPWGT; civilian noninstitutional employed
universes.hours: Usual hours at primary job, PEHRUSL1 in [0,99]; hours vary and NIU excluded, coverage explicit

wageBreakRule: CPS public-use earnings rounding/topcoding changed 2023–2024; retain medians and explicit limited-comparability warning; no unqualified across-break wage result

weighting.earnings: PWORWGT / 10000, weighted median; nominal; not OEWS hourly wages
weighting.employment: PWCMPWGT / 10000; monthly sum averaged over 12 months
weighting.quantiles: Phase 2 native occupation-count midrank groups fixed before outcome inspection; outcomes employment-weighted
